# U179: Metrics in and out: as Amara, a Metrics file that adds two metrics and changes another’s caveats is counted “2 new metrics, 1 metric changed”, and the check page says the stages after loading and that the new metric is Draft with what it needs, a row with the name of the row above and one retiring without a reason are Must fix in the form’s words, and left out the rest saves; the new metric is in the library; with the Metric library off, the same file says once that the Metrics sheet was not read

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-SHEET`
- **Budget:** at most 8 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity`, `logged` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/data/import` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U179

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Choose “metrics.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `` file('metrics.csv', [ `,Retried test share ${device},%,Lower is better,,,`, `${before.id},${before.name},${before.unit},${before.direction === 'lower' ? 'Lower is better' : 'Higher is better'},Read with the release calendar.,,`, `,Queue depth ${device},jobs,Lower is better,,,`, `,Queue depth ${device},jobs,Lower is better,,,`, `${other.id},,,,,Retire,`, ]) ``, where `const file = (name, rows) => csvFile(name, 'ID,Metric,Unit,Direction,Caveats,Action,Reason\n' + rows.join('\n') + '\n')`; `const live = (await h.snapshot()).modules.metrics.metrics.filter((m) => !m.removedAt && !m.retiredAt)`; `const [before, other] = live`.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/check”.
- **Check:** “Rows 4 and 5 are both called “Queue depth {device}”. A metric’s name is used once.” is shown (else: a name used twice is not a Must fix).
- **Check:** “Say why it is retired, in the Reason column. Its goals will show this.” is shown (else: retiring without a reason is not a Must fix).
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ The way in is Import's own (U95): the Metrics sheet comes in through the same door as every other sheet.
- **Check:** (`entry`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “must fix”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** “2 new metrics, 1 metric changed.” is shown (else: the preview does not count the metrics).
- _Note:_ The sheet's own notes on the check page, as on the Data tables' preview (#570 review): the stages after loading, and a new metric that names only its unit and direction is Draft, with what it still needs.
- **Check:** “Stages after loading:” is shown (else: the import does not say the stages after loading).
- **Check:** ““Retried test share {device}” is Draft: it needs a meaning” is shown (else: the import does not say what a Draft metric still needs).
- **Step.** Press the “Leave these 2 rows out and save the rest” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Leave them out” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) there are 1 of the main button in the main (`main .btn.primary`) (else: the preview has more than one primary action).
- **Step.** Press the “Import 3 changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/done/imp_”.
- **Check:** “2 new metrics, 1 metric changed” is shown (else: the saved import does not count the metrics).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `` ms.some((m) => m.name === `Retried test share ${device}` && m.ownerId === 'amara') && ms.find((m) => m.id === before.id).caveats === 'Read with the release calendar.' && !ms.find((m) => m.id === other.id).retiredAt ``, where `const live = (await h.snapshot()).modules.metrics.metrics.filter((m) => !m.removedAt && !m.retiredAt)`; `const [before, other] = live`; `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const ms = s.modules.metrics.metrics`. Else it says: the metrics were not saved as the file said.
- Go to `/metrics` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Retried test share {device}” is shown (else: the new metric is not in the library).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ The Metric library off: the file is read, its Metrics sheet said once and not read.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Metric” tick box.
- **Check:** “Metric library is off in” is shown (else: the Metric library does not switch off).
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Choose “metrics-off.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `` file('metrics-off.csv', [`,Cache warm share ${device},%,Higher is better,,,`]) ``, where `const file = (name, rows) => csvFile(name, 'ID,Metric,Unit,Direction,Caveats,Action,Reason\n' + rows.join('\n') + '\n')`.
- **Check:** “Metric library is off in” is shown (else: the import does not say the Metrics sheet was not read).
- **Check:** “so the Metrics sheet was not read.” is shown (else: the import does not say the Metrics sheet was not read).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `` !(await h.snapshot()).modules.metrics.metrics.some((m) => m.name === `Cache warm share ${device}`) ``. Else it says: a Metrics sheet was read with the Metric library off.
- Close this browser.
